WITH owned AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        library.id,
        COALESCE(revision.current_revision, 0) AS current_sync_revision,
        COALESCE(revision.reading_revision, 0) AS reading_revision,
        COALESCE(revision.other_revision, 0) AS other_revision,
        pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(library.id, 0))
    FROM libraries AS library
    LEFT JOIN sync_library_revision AS revision ON revision.library_id = library.id
    WHERE library.id = $1 AND library.user_id = $2
),
changed AS (
    INSERT INTO sync_reading_position_state(
        library_id, book_id, cfi, progress,
        changed_at, client_id, client_seq, version_rank, event_id
    )
    SELECT $1, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10
    FROM owned
    WHERE current_sync_revision >= $11
    ON CONFLICT (library_id, book_id) DO UPDATE SET
        cfi = EXCLUDED.cfi,
        progress = EXCLUDED.progress,
        changed_at = EXCLUDED.changed_at,
        client_id = EXCLUDED.client_id,
        client_seq = EXCLUDED.client_seq,
        version_rank = EXCLUDED.version_rank,
        event_id = EXCLUDED.event_id,
        server_seq = DEFAULT
    RETURNING server_seq
)
SELECT
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owned) AS authorized,
    COALESCE((SELECT current_sync_revision FROM owned) < $11, FALSE) AS cursor_ahead,
    COALESCE((SELECT current_sync_revision FROM owned) <= $11, FALSE) AS caught_up,
    (SELECT reading_revision FROM owned) AS reading_revision,
    (SELECT other_revision FROM owned) AS other_revision,
    changed.server_seq
FROM (VALUES (1)) AS sentinel(value)
LEFT JOIN changed ON TRUE;
